title.value: Learning with Gradient Descent and Weakly Convex Losses
title.justification: The paper is focused on investigating how gradient descent performs when dealing with weakly convex losses.
title.quote: We study the learning performance of gradient descent when the empirical risk is weakly convex...

analysis.description: This paper investigates the learning performance and generalization of gradient descent when the empirical risk is weakly convex. The research provides broader generalization error bounds and explores the implicit biases and scaling involved in neural networks, particularly focusing on the stability and generalization error control through the Hessian's smallest negative Eigenvalue.

type.justification: The paper deals with theoretical aspects of learning with gradient descent by providing theoretical bounds and analyses rather than empirical experiments or practical implementations.
type.quote: By showing that this eigenvalue can control the stability of gradient descent, generalisation error bounds are proven that hold under a wider range of step sizes compared to previous work.

name.justification: The core of the paper is about optimization techniques, specifically gradient descent, in the context of weakly convex loss functions.
name.quote: This work investigates the generalization performance of gradient descent on loss functions that satisfy a notion of weak convexity.

name.justification: The paper is centralized around theoretical advancements and proofs regarding learning paradigms.
name.quote: The assumption relates to the loss’s curvature as encoded by the Hessian spectrum.

name.justification: The paper explores the implications of neural network scaling and biases in the context of weakly convex losses and gradient descent.
name.quote: In the case of a two layer neural network, we demonstrate that the empirical risk can satisfy a notion of local weak convexity.

name.justification: The paper provides an analysis of two-layer neural networks in the context of gradient descent with weakly convex losses.
name.quote: Utilising our population risk bounds, insights are then gained into the influence of neural network scaling on learning. Specifically, we consider a loss that is the composition of a convex function and a two layer neural network.

is_contributed.justification: The model is an existing concept used to validate theoretical results rather than a new model contributed by this paper.
is_contributed.quote: ...a two layer neural network, we demonstrate that the empirical risk can satisfy a notion of local weak convexity...

is_executed.justification: The mention of execution refers to theoretical analysis rather than practical execution on hardware like GPU or CPU.
is_executed.quote: When the loss is a composition of a convex function and a two layer neural network, we prove that the weak convexity parameter is on the order of the network scaling.

is_compared.justification: The paper focuses on theoretical implications without numeric comparison to other models.
is_compared.quote: ...our results and empirical evidence, we argue that networks with smaller scaling are biased towards weights with larger norm...

referenced_paper_title.justification: There is no specific referenced paper title for 'Two Layer Neural Network' as it is a generally established model.
